findings.title: Stale hold count accepted by reopenForHold
findings.disposition_rationale: The CLI has no access to the hold record (hold.json stays in the store, never in the run dir). The spec's Failure modes section names a wrong hold count and bounds it: each value reopens at most once and values above graft.build_review_hold_limit reopen nothing.

occurrences.title: Stale hold count accepted by reopenForHold

findings.title: Reopen resets attempt counters per call
findings.refutation: reopenForHold returns early when n is in reopened_for_holds
findings.disposition_rationale: The reset runs once per hold count, guarded by reopened_for_holds, and attempts are persisted before each attempt, so later chunk calls count on from the reset. Tests: a repeated n reopens nothing; a second hold count gets one full budget of retryLimit + 1 attempts.

occurrences.title: Reopen resets attempt counters per call

findings.title: proveStage checks ledger presence only
findings.action: Validate the ledger's contents at restore.
findings.refutation: adjudicationIdentity is the mechanical backstop (spec section 4)
findings.disposition_rationale: The spec fixes the check at presence. A mismatched or torn ledger fails the adjudication identity in --assemble and starts a fresh pass over the shipping code, never a wrong admit.

findings.title: reopened_for_holds records n when nothing reopened
findings.action: Record n only when an entry was reopened.
findings.disposition_rationale: The spec's reopen procedure step 6 requires recording n even when nothing was reopened; this is what makes the flag idempotent. The stale-n scenario it fears is the first finding.

occurrences.title: reopened_for_holds records n when nothing reopened

findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/resume-store.js::stage derived from source dir rather than staged copy
findings.title: stage derived from source dir rather than staged copy
findings.action: Derive stage from lock.stage after the copy.
findings.disposition_rationale: The spec derives stage from the same src dir; nothing writes the issue dir while a stash runs (the build turn has ended), so the race is not reachable.

findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/build-judge-evidence.js::fresh ledger records n before the pass completes
findings.title: Fresh ledger records n before the pass completes
findings.action: Defer recording n until the pass completes.
findings.disposition_rationale: A case only parks as an outage after its full retryLimit + 1 attempts, so a parked entry in a fresh pass has already spent that hold's budget; an interrupted pass leaves the entry pending, not parked.
